event.title: Pope Leo XIV Warns AI Could Undermine Humanity During France Visit
event.canonical_title: Pope Leo XIV Warns AI Could Undermine Humanity During France Visit
event.summary: Pope Leo XIV expressed concerns about the impact of artificial intelligence, describing it as a potential 'paradise of machines' that could undermine humanity. He raised fundamental questions regarding human existence in the context of technological advancement, nuclear threats, and other existential risks during his visit to France.
